brace_model.title: Component Model for Steel Bracings
brace_model.intro: This web-based interactive interface computes the basic parameters for predictive modeling of steel bracings based on their basic material and geometric properties. For further information refer to Eurocode 8 Part 3.
brace_model.cross_section_type_help: Select the cross-sectional shape of the bracing member
brace_model.select_steel_profile_help: Here, you may choose to either select a W-Shape from the AISC database or input your own dimensions using the sliders below
brace_model.steel_type_help: Select a standard steel grade or specify manually the material overstrength (Omega) and the nominal yield strength, fy)
brace_model.associated_member_lengths_help: Specify the associated member lengths as defined in the definition in the upper left corner
brace_model.figcaption: Diagonal bracing member framed into gusset plates at both ends, with buckling length lcr and end-to-end length lee; section A–A gives the cross-section geometry. The normalised axial response is modelled separately in tension — elastic loading to Nt / Nb,Rd followed by a yield plateau — and in compression, where the buckling resistance Nb,e degrades towards the post-buckling capacity Nuc.
brace_model.tension_sub: Yield plateau · Nt / N vs. δ / δy
brace_model.compression_sub: Post-buckling degradation · Nc / N vs. δ / δb

column_model.title: Predictive Model for Steel Wide-Flange Columns
column_model.select_steel_profile_help: Here, you may choose to either select a W-Shape from the AISC database or input your own dimensions using the sliders below
column_model.member_loading_properties_help: Here you need to specify the beam full length (L), the beam unbraced length (Lb), which is defined as the distance from the column face to the nearest lateral brace, the expected yield stress, Fy of the steel material, the capping-to-yield ratio Mc/My, the expected residual strength ratio, K, and the ultimate rotation θu of the steel component.
column_model.figcaption: Cantilever wide-flange column under constant gravity load Pg and imposed lateral drift δY, laterally braced at the top, with an inflection point at mid-height of the unbraced length Lb. The cross-section geometry parameterises the idealised monotonic moment–rotation backbone at right: elastic stiffness Ke up to the yield moment My, hardening to the capping moment Mc over the plastic rotation θp, post-capping softening over θpc, and a residual plateau Mr held to the ultimate rotation θult.
column_model.predictive_model_help: Provided that the steel member is in double curvature

connection_model.title: Backbone Curve Plotter for Steel Components
connection_model.intro: Construct the backbone curve of beams with RBS and beams other-than-RBS. For further information refer to {reference}
connection_model.select_steel_profile_help: Here, you may choose to either select a W-Shape from the AISC database or input your own dimensions using the sliders below
connection_model.specify_member_properties_help: Here you need to specify the beam full length (L), the beam unbraced length (Lb), which is defined as the distance from the column face to the nearest lateral brace, the expected yield stress, Fy of the steel material, the capping-to-yield ratio Mc/My, the expected residual strength ratio, K, and the ultimate rotation θu of the steel component.
connection_model.figcaption: Beam-to-column subassembly: the beam spans its full length L between column faces, with the unbraced length Lb measured from the column face to the nearest lateral brace; the composite slab is hatched. The beam cross-section parameterises the idealised monotonic moment–rotation backbone at right: elastic stiffness Ke up to the yield moment My, hardening to the capping moment Mc over the plastic rotation θp, post-capping softening over θpc, and a residual plateau Mr held to the ultimate rotation θult.
connection_model.component_models_help: Provided that the steel member is in double curvature

hss_model.title: Predictive Model for Hollow Structural Steel Columns
hss_model.select_hss_profile_help: Here, you may input dimensions using the sliders below
hss_model.member_loading_properties_help: Here you need to specify the beam full length (L), the beam unbraced length (Lb), which is defined as the distance from the column face to the nearest lateral brace, the expected yield stress, Fy of the steel material, the capping-to-yield ratio Mc/My, the expected residual strength ratio, K, and the ultimate rotation θu of the steel component.
hss_model.figcaption: Hollow structural section column under constant axial load N and imposed lateral drift δY, with an inflection point along the unbraced length Lb. The tube geometry — width b, depth h, wall thickness t and corner radii ri / ro — parameterises the idealised monotonic moment–rotation backbone at right: elastic stiffness Ke up to the yield moment My, hardening to the capping moment Mc over the plastic rotation θp, post-capping softening over θpc, and a residual plateau Mr held to the ultimate rotation θult.
hss_model.predictive_model_columns_help: Provided that the steel member is in double curvature

material_model.title: Material Model
material_model.intro: This web based interactive interface computes the hysteretic behavior of typical steels under inelastic cyclic straining. For further information refer to {hartloper} The uniaxial loading protocols are based on work by {castro}
material_model.intro_castro: de Castro e Sousa et al. (2020)
material_model.select_steel_material_help: Here you can select a steel material from the available list and with the sliders below you can check the sensitivity of the updated Voce and Chaboche constitutive model to the input material model parameters. The model is displayed based on four selected strain-based protocols for the same set of input model parameters.

brace_fragility.title: Fragility Curve Plotter for Steel Bracings
brace_fragility.intro: This interactive module plots univariate and multivariate fragility curves for steel bracings of various types of cross sections. the multivariate curves depict the dependence of the fragility curve on member slenderness. For further information refer to {reference}.
brace_fragility.cross_section_help: Select the appropriate cross sectional shape of the bracing member to visualize the corresponding fragility curve.
brace_fragility.multivariate_fragilities_sub: P(DS) over story drift ratio × KL / r

column_fragility.title: Fragility Curve Plotter for Wide-Flange Steel Columns
column_fragility.intro: This module plots univariate and multivariate fragility curves for wide-flange steel columns depending on their primary loading and geometric characteristics. For further information please refer to {reference}.
column_fragility.parameters_help: Please provide the imposed gravity-induced axial load ratio, Pg/Pyn and the web slenderness ratio, h/tw of the wide-flange cross section of the steel column.
column_fragility.fragility_curves_sub: P(DS ≥ ds) vs. story drift ratio
column_fragility.surface_fragility_curves_sub: P(DS) over story drift ratio × h / tw

connection_fragility.title: Fragility Curve Plotter for Steel Components
connection_fragility.intro: This tab introduces a web-based interactive module for visualizing fragility curves of Pre- and Post-Northridge beam-to-column connections. For further information refer to {lignos} and {ramirez}.
connection_fragility.figcaption: Pre-Northridge beam-to-column moment connection — definition of {l} and {db}.

brace.title: Braces
brace.description: Steel brace tests under reversed cyclic axial loading, covering a range of cross-section shapes, slenderness ratios and boundary conditions. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full specimen detail and digitized test data.
brace.chart_tests_per_year_bc: Tests per year by boundary condition

column.title: Columns
column.description: Wide-flange steel column tests under combined axial load and cyclic lateral drift, covering hot-rolled and built-up sections. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full specimen detail and digitized test data.
column.chart_tests_per_year_bc: Tests per year by boundary condition

connection.title: Connections
connection.description: Beam-to-column moment connection tests under reversed cyclic and monotonic loading, categorized per AISC-358-16. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full specimen detail and digitized test data.

hss.title: HSS Columns
hss.description: Hollow structural section column tests under combined axial load and cyclic lateral loading, covering a range of depth-to-thickness ratios and loading angles. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full specimen detail and digitized test data.
hss.chart_tests_per_year_failure_mode: Tests per year by failure mode

ebf.title: EBF Links
ebf.description: Eccentrically braced frame link tests, classified per AISC-341 link length categories across isolated, frame and system test configurations. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full specimen detail and digitized test data.
ebf.chart_tests_per_year_section: Tests per year by section type
ebf.chart_tests_per_year_classification: Tests per year by link classification

material.title: Cyclic Coupons
material.description: Cyclic coupon tests on structural steels with calibrated Updated Voce-Chaboche material model parameters. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full coupon detail and digitized stress-strain data.
material.chart_coupons_per_year_profile: Coupons per year by profile type

tensile_coupon.title: Tensile Coupons
tensile_coupon.description: Monotonic tensile coupon tests on structural steels, with engineering stress-strain curves and standardized mechanical properties. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full coupon detail and digitized stress-strain data.
tensile_coupon.chart_coupons_per_year_profile: Coupons per year by profile type

ductile_fracture.title: Ductile Fracture
ductile_fracture.description: Ductile fracture tests on notched steel coupons with simulated stress-state histories (triaxiality, Lode angle) and calibrated fracture model parameters. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full specimen detail, test data and SEM imagery.
ductile_fracture.chart_tests_per_year: Tests per year by specimen type

residual.title: Residual Stresses
residual.description: Residual stress measurements on hot-rolled and welded steel profiles, with flange and web distribution data. Filter through the filters panel, the table column filters or the charts below; click a row for the full specimen detail and measured distributions.
residual.chart_specimens_per_year_profile: Specimens per year by profile type

tooltip.intro: The Connections Database presents data from early 1970s on beam-to-column connections under reversed cyclic and monotonic loading. The primary data involve the global behavior of the connection and the decomposed panel zone shear versus shear distortion, deduced beam end moment versus chord rotation, whenever available.

hero.title: Open data for {emphasis}{break}steel structures.
hero.lede: Curated experimental databases and state-of-the-art component models for performance-based earthquake engineering — assembled worldwide since the 1970s, fully digitized, freely accessible.

databases.title: Nine curated datasets, one consistent format.
databases.sub: Digitized experimental data from labs worldwide. Filter by geometry, material and loading protocol; export reproducibly; cite original sources.

tools.blurb: Beyond data: interactive backbone curves and fragility surfaces for direct use in nonlinear analyses.

gallery.title: Behind the data: full-scale testing at RESSLab.

about.title: A service to the earthquake-engineering community.
about.lede: The databases in RESSLab Hub were assembled as a service to the research and practice communities in earthquake engineering. Data are fully digitized from experimental reports and shared under the {ccLicence} and the {gplLicence} licences. EPFL, and the researchers who performed the experiments, make no warranties to the accuracy of the information collected and provided on this website.

contributors.title: People who built the Hub.
contributors.credits: {enac} developed the web-based interfaces, visualisation features and search capabilities for the assembled databases. We sincerely thank the many researchers worldwide who generously shared their test data for the development of the structural component databases.

citation.title: Citing RESSLab Hub
citation.note: Database users should cite the original references for each test description in addition to these databases.

funding.historyConnections: An earlier version of the Connections database was assembled by {lignos} and the late {krawinkler} within the NEES project {neesProject}, and significantly expanded by Andronikos Skiadopoulos during his doctoral studies at EPFL. The Columns database was assembled by Prof. Ahmed Elkady and Subash Ghimire under the SNSF project {snsfProject}.
funding.support: Report technical problems to {lignos}. See also the {disclaimer} and {privacy}.

contribute.title: New submission
contribute.description: Add experiments to the open steel database: pick the target database, fill or import the metadata, attach measured responses. Everything is checked automatically as you go.
contribute.draft_notice: Submitting opens a review request on the RESSLab data repository — a curator approves it before the data goes live.
